hero.label: Artistic Portfolio
hero.title: ION VIRLAN
hero.subtitle: Jazz Double Bassist & Composer
hero.description: A musician of Moldovan origins connecting Eastern European folk with modern jazz. Active on stage and in the studio in Wrocław, he creates music drawing on Balkan traditions and Western improvisation.

profile.label: Artist Profile
profile.title: Artist Profile
profile.description: Bassist, jazz double bassist, composer and arranger originally from Chișinău

flagship.label: Flagship Project
flagship.title: Ion Virlan Quintet
flagship.description: Ion Virlan Quintet is an original ensemble established in 2024 as part of the prestigious Gaude Polonia scholarship.

fusion.title: Cultural Fusion
fusion.description: A combination of deep Balkan folk tradition sensitivity with modern European jazz language.

composition.title: Original Composition
composition.description: The ensemble's repertoire is based exclusively on Ion's original compositions and his innovative arrangements of traditional folk songs.

album.title: Album
album.description: The main goal of creating the quintet was to produce and record an album that transforms traditional folk themes into vital, energetic contemporary jazz pieces.

achievements.label: Scholarships & Achievements
achievements.title: SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAMS & ACHIEVEMENTS
achievements.description: Double scholarship recipient of the Minister of Culture and National Heritage's Gaude Polonia program (editions 2021 and 2024).

scholarship2021.title: Scholarship 2021
scholarship2021.description: Development of first original jazz arrangements for traditional Moldovan folk music.

scholarship2024.title: Scholarship 2024
scholarship2024.description: Completion of work on the original album of the Ion Virlan Quintet ensemble.
